mobile:
CMPRI Staff Notes · Mobile preview · 393 px viewport · Mock data only
Preview help and hashtag counts

Post, reply, type @mentions for people, roles, or locations (try @Pool, @Lobby, or @Room 207), type #hashtags, use your device’s emoji keyboard, and open #1234 or #5678. Plain room numbers are not automatically parsed. Pick photos, videos, or any file up to 100 MB each; desktop files can be dropped into the text input. Animated GIFs appear inline at a modest size. Photos have small thumbnails; click either to open its original size, limited to the modal screen. Video play buttons open landscape or portrait players fitted to the screen. Enlarged media has no title, header, or border: only media over a blurred background. Tap outside it or press Escape to close. Older comments are already in the scrolling list; no expand button is needed. Pasted/shared keyboard GIF files are accepted where the browser exposes them; keyboard links or unsupported share payloads cannot become animated files automatically. Front Desk enters a name in the comment box first and selects OK. That name is retained through modal closes and refreshes for the tab session, then used on later posts. Captured names are display-only mentions.

To inspect the button flag, close the notes, then add a mock incoming note. Managers clear the flag after viewing the unread note. Front Desk keeps it until 6 AM on the third calendar day after posting, America/Chicago. Tuesday → Friday. No separate notification is generated.

Sample staff and notes are fictional. Posted notes, replies, and local attachments are saved in this browser. Selected GIPHY IDs are saved; GIFs reload directly from GIPHY. Clearing browser data removes saved test posts. The Front Desk name uses tab-session storage and survives refresh; closing the tab normally ends it. Browser-restored sessions may retain it, and viewers that block session storage can only retain the name while the preview stays open. General files are accepted and listed; image/video/audio content can be previewed locally.
